in_hebrew.name: Lyssa
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Goddess of the Moon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lyssa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Lyssa is the goddess of madness, frenzy, and rabies. Her name derives from the Greek word 'lyssos', meaning 'loosener', due to her ability to unleash wild, untamed emotions. In Christianity, Lyssa represents the transformative power of the Holy Spirit, turning chaos into divine order.
